settings.title: Product details
settings.content:
• Stainless-steel padlock pendant and chain.
  • 45 cm chain length.
  • Black, silver, gold, and rose-gold color options.
  • One- or two-line front engraving, up to 15 characters per line.

settings.title: How engraving works
settings.content: 1. Enter line 1 and, if wanted, line 2. 2. Check the lock preview and spelling. 3. We engrave the front and send a photo proof before shipping.
